record.field: # Assign to sales manager for high-value leads sales_manager = env.ref('cater.user_catering_manager', raise_if_not_found=False) if sales_manager and not record.user_id: record.user_id = sales_manager.id record.message_post(body='Auto-assigned to Sales Manager due to high expected revenue.')

# Notify assigned user if record.user_id: record.activity_schedule( 'mail.mail_activity_data_todo', summary='Convert Lead to Booking', note='This lead has been marked as Won. Please convert it to an event booking.', user_id=record.user_id.id, ) record.message_post( body='Lead marked as Won! Next step: Convert to Event Booking.', subject='Lead Won - Action Required' )

high_value_tag = env.ref('cater.tag_high_value', raise_if_not_found=False) if high_value_tag and high_value_tag not in record.tag_ids: record.tag_ids = [(4, high_value_tag.id)] record.message_post(body='Tagged as High Value - Expected revenue exceeds ₵5,000.')
